summary.intent: Work on GSD todo #9: implement SDK client self-bootstrap of the folder tree from the root IPNS key, eliminating the 'Folder not loaded' bug class where the web had to pre-seed folder state before every SDK call.
summary.outcome: Implemented `ensureFolderLoaded` DFS walk + `requireFolder` chokepoint in the SDK, passed `rootIpnsKeypair` from web `vaultStore`, verified with typecheck/179 tests/CodeRabbit/security review, and opened PR #498. Two follow-up cleanup items captured as a new GSD todo.

repo: `CipherBoxClientConfig` (types.ts:44-88) held `rootIpnsName` + `rootFolderKey` but never the root IPNS Ed25519 signing keypair — that lived only in web `vaultStore.rootIpnsKeypair`, already guarded non-null at useAuth.ts:281 but never forwarded to the SDK.

`FolderState` (not `FolderEntry`) is the folderTree value type; it carries the per-folder IPNS signing keypair (`ipnsKeypair`) at types.ts:102 — child FolderEntry records carry it as hex-encrypted blobs that must be ECIES-unwrapped.
`loadFolder(ipnsName, folderKey, ipnsKeypair)` at client.ts:345 is the only async load primitive; caller must supply all three — no auto/lazy load existed before this change.
`withOperation` is reentrant-safe (emits telemetry events only, no lock), so `ensureFolderLoaded` calling `loadFolder` inside a `withOperation`-wrapped method is fine.
`integration.test.ts` requires a live backend at localhost:3000 and is implicitly skipped via `CI=1`; running without it causes 3 false failures.
`pnpm typecheck` rebuilds the full dep chain (sdk-core → sdk → web tsc -b) — must be run after any public-API change to the SDK.
The `.planning/security/` directory already contained prior review files; the command creates a new timestamped file there.
GSD STATE.md pending todo count must be manually updated when todos are added/completed — it is not auto-derived from the filesystem.

code.finding: CipherBoxClientConfig — no rootIpnsKeypair field; only rootIpnsName (string) and rootFolderKey (AES-256). The Ed25519 IPNS signing key for the root folder was the missing piece.
FolderState type: holds ipnsKeypair (Ed25519, line 102) per-folder. Tree linkage is implicit via children array; no parent pointer.
Client private fields: internalVaultKeypair (line 61) and internalRootFolderKey (line 62) are defensive copies of config values; originals are also re-pointed. No rootIpnsKeypair field existed.
registerFolder: bridge method that writes a FolderState with metadata:null into folderTree.set. Caller must supply ipnsKeypair — no crypto happens here.

loadFolder: only true async load primitive. Calls sdkCore.loadFolderMetadata, sets full FolderState including metadata. Every mutation method requires the folder to already be in folderTree before this change.

11 distinct 'Folder not loaded' / 'Parent folder not loaded' throw sites across createFolder, renameItem, moveItem (x2), deleteItem, uploadFile, uploadFiles, replaceFile, restoreFileVersion, deleteFileVersion, shareFolder — all collapsed into requireFolder() after /simplify.
vaultStore.rootIpnsKeypair is already guarded non-null here before initSdkClient is called — safe to pass directly to CipherBoxClientConfig without additional null-checking.

workflow: 5-agent parallel code-mapping workflow before implementation is highly effective for understanding a complex stateful class before editing it.

/simplify's 4-angle review (reuse/simplification/efficiency/altitude) converged independently on the same `requireFolder` chokepoint — high-confidence signal that a repeated pattern is the right extraction target.
Corrupt-sibling resilience (try/catch + continue inside a DFS walk) is worth adding proactively when a bad subtree could deny access to a valid sibling.
Security review files added no value when the same diff was already adversarially reviewed by a dedicated security agent + CodeRabbit — skip the formal report artifact for in-session reviews.
CodeRabbit CLI `--agent` mode with `--base-commit` scopes the review precisely to the branch diff; exit 0 + findings:0 in the JSON payload = clean.
Pre-commit lint-staged will auto-fix prettier nits on commit, but you still need to run prettier manually before the final lint check to avoid a wasted CI cycle.

friction: TypeErrors in ensureFolderLoaded after initial implementation: `FolderState | undefined` (from Map.get) vs `| null` (from loadFolder return) mismatch required a second edit pass.
integration.test.ts produces 3 misleading failures without a live backend — needed `CI=1` to surface the real unit-test result.
Prettier line-wrap nit surfaced after ESLint pass, requiring a second auto-fix loop before committing.
PR creation warning about '2 uncommitted changes' (Cargo.lock + .planning/intel/) — pre-existing untracked files that weren't part of this work but create visual noise.
open_items: Remove ~16 web-side `ensureFolderRegistered` calls and the web `useFolderNavigation` unwrap path — now redundant no-ops since the SDK self-heals; deferred until self-bootstrap proves out in production. Captured as GSD todo (.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-16-remove-redundant-web-folder-seeding-now-that-sdk-self-bootst.md).
Add negative-cache to `ensureFolderLoaded` so an unreachable/withheld target doesn't re-walk the full tree on every call — availability concern, not correctness. Also captured in same todo.
New web-e2e `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` only runs on main-push, not on PRs — the reload-restore regression gap won't be caught by PR CI until then.
The web `useFolderNavigation` unwrap path is now a duplicate of the SDK's DFS logic — consolidation is the right long-term shape but requires deleting the web-side seeding callers first.
